Design Style:
Name: "Hachi Broadcast & Godínez Survival"
Concept: >
Internet dog culture,
WhatsApp stickers,
Discord culture,
Brainrot Meme,
visual essay,
corporate collapse and godínez,
reverse Tamagotchi,
empathy engineering,
Mexican dictionary of emotions,
experimental motion graphics,
2000s MTV,
Hachi Broadcast graphic design.
Slides are structured as a meme channel, internet culture show, and visual essay.
Hachi (a Maltese with a chihuahua apple-head, messy fur, disproportionately large eyes due to neoteny, tongue out) is the protagonist and narrative Trojan horse.
The visual narrative mixes the chaos of public transport, KPI saturation, and office existentialism with PNG cutouts, WhatsApp/Discord stickers, visible HTML/CSS code, and stress metrics.
